name: Munakata (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Munakata city emblem in green, red and navy: a green stylised figure with a red disc above a navy oval.
history: Municipal flag of Munakata, a city in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 2003.

features.role: Munakata city emblem — a green stylised figure with a red disc above a navy oval
